item.title: Intel Announces Inference-Optimized Xe3P Graphics Card with 160GB VRAM
item.description:
📝 This new graphics card is codenamed Crescent Island and is built on their next-gen Xe3P Celestial micro-architecture. In addition to being optimized around performance-per-Watt, Crescent Island will also be air cooled and cost-optimized. Long story short, Intel is announcing Crescent Island today as a Xe3LP + 160GB LPDDR5X offering for H2'2026 or later that will be AI inference optimized around power efficiency and cost.
🔗 Read more: https://www.phoronix.com/review/intel-crescent-island
